items.evidence: Log shows master mix 106/40/4/2 µL, 19 µL to A1:G1, 2.5 µL fwd and rev primers paired A1..G1/A2..G2, and 1 µL template from A1,A1,B1,C1,A1,A1,D1 to A1..G1 with 3x15 µL mixes.
Log has 19 µL water, 5 µL rCutSmart, 1 µL DpnI to each of A1:G1, then 3x30 µL mix. Code comments record the 37/65°C incubation and Zymo cleanup, followed by protocol.pause.
Log shows 7 µL water, 2 µL T4 buffer, 3 µL frag 2, 2 µL frag 5, 3 µL frag 6, 2 µL frags 1/3/4/7 to A1..D1, and 1 µL enzyme mix with 5x mix per well.

The Golden Gate program (30x 37/16°C, 60°C, 4°C hold) and the cleanup are recorded via protocol.comment. The log then shows 5 µL from assembly A1:D1 to cells A1:D1 and 250 µL LB to each, with heat shock and recovery comments.

The move helpers take a fresh tip per destination or pair, and the log shows a pick up and drop for each transfer. The shared master-mix tube and stocks are only aspirated with fresh tips, so there is no cross-contamination.

judge.summary: The agent's protocol matches the specified volumes, well pairings and order in the simulator log. Off-robot steps are recorded as comments and pauses, and fresh tips are used for every transfer.
